incident_report.incident: Bumped at the start. Near the 400 Metres was bumped. Over the concluding stages made slight contact with ROMANTIC FANTASY when that runner shifted out under pressure.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Shifted out under pressure over the concluding stages and made slight contact with JOYFUL PROSPERITY.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly.
For some distance approaching the 1900 Metres raced tight to the inside of ROMANTIC FANTASY which lay in.

Near the 400 Metres shifted out and made contact with JOYFUL PROSPERITY. D B McMonagle (CONSPIRACY WITNESS) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that approaching the first turn he allowed his mount to shift in when insufficiently clear of ROSEWOOD FLEETFOOT, resulting in that runner striking the heels of CONSPIRACY WITNESS, blundering badly and losing its running.   D B McMonagle was suspended from riding in races for one Hong Kong raceday to be conducted on Sunday, 29 March 2026 at Sha Tin.  In addition, Jockey McMonagle was fined $55,000.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 3 and also considered his excellent race riding record. <26/3/2026 Additional Veterinary Report> The Veterinary Surgeon reported that ROSEWOOD FLEETFOOT was lame in its left front leg on the morning after racing. Before being allowed to race again, ROSEWOOD FLEETFOOT will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Raced keenly in the early stages.  Lay out on the Home Turn.  K Teetan stated that after settling back in the field he was satisfied with the horse’s finishing effort as it was disadvantaged by the early and middle stages of the event being run outside of standard time.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Slow to begin.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.

D B McMonagle pleaded guilty to a careless riding charge for causing interference approaching the first turn (see ROSEWOOD FLEETFOOT).  Near the 550 Metres became unbalanced when racing tight between ROSEWOOD FLEETFOOT and JOYFUL PROSPERITY which shifted in slightly when making a forward move.  D B McMonagle stated that from a wide barrier and in a race where there appeared to be a lack of pace he was instructed to go forward.  He added he could offer no explanation for the horse’s failure to finish the race off in the Home Straight.

M Chadwick stated that it was not his intention to settle as far forward as he did, however, he observed a position behind CONSPIRACY WITNESS in the early stages which he considered to be an advantageous position.  He added whilst his mount travelled well throughout the event, when placed under pressure in the Home Straight, SUPER HONG KONG raced "flat” and did not finish the race off.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Bumped at the start.  J Orman stated that after leading the event his mount gave ground in the Home Straight and he could offer no explanation for its failure to finish the race off.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  C Y Ho was warned in relation to using his whip on a horse which was clearly out of contention.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped on jumping.  Near the 500 Metres made contact with PRESTIGE SUPERIOR when taken in by ABSOLUTE AWAKENED.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.

Made contact with a rail before leaving the Parade Ring, was examined by the Veterinary Officer at the Start and passed suitable to race.  Jumped only fairly.  Making the first turn near the 1300 Metres raced tight to the inside of TAKE ACTION when TAKE ACTION was taken in slightly by YIU CHEUNG VICTORY.
Raced wide and without cover until near the 700 Metres.
Was left racing wide and without cover from the 700 Metres.  K C Leung pleaded guilty to a careless riding charge for causing interference near the 500 Metres (see PRESTIGE SUPERIOR).

Bumped on jumping.  H Bowman stated that he was obliged to make some use of his mount in the early stages to go forward.  He said in the Home Straight RAGGA BOMB finished the race off in a one-paced manner and over the concluding stages was eased when racing in restricted room between ABSOLUTE AWAKENED and YIU CHEUNG VICTORY which was taken out slightly by KOLACHI, which prevented him from riding his mount out to the end of the race.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Shifted in at the start and became unbalanced when it made contact with RAGGA BOMB.  Leaving the 500 Metres was steadied to avoid PRESTIGE SUPERIOR when that runner was checked.  PRECISION HOPE was then held up between the 500 Metres and the 300 Metres as PRESTIGE SUPERIOR gave ground.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have a respiratory condition which requires further assessment. A further assessment of the respiratory condition did not reveal any significant findings.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Trainer D J Hall confirmed that from a wide barrier he had instructed J Orman to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages.
No report.

Bumped on jumping.  K C Leung (ABSOLUTE AWAKENED) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 500 Metres he allowed his mount to shift in when not clear of TAKE ACTION, resulting in TAKE ACTION being taken in onto PRESTIGE SUPERIOR which was checked when it lost its running.  K C Leung was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 15 April 2026 and to expire on Monday, 20 April 2026 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his good race riding record.  H T Mo stated that from a favourable barrier and with his mount stepping up in distance he was asked to hold a more forward position than its previous race starts.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Shifted out shortly after the start and was bumped.  Approaching the 300 Metres blundered when being shifted to the outside of WATCH THIS ONE to obtain clear running.  Sent for sampling post-race.
After travelling a short distance made contact with GOLDEN EMPIRE due to both runners shifting ground.  Leaving the 900 Metres shifted in and made contact with GOLDEN EMPIRE.

Jumped awkwardly and lost ground.  Shortly after the start blundered when awkwardly placed on the heels of SUNNY Q when being shifted behind that runner.  Held up making the Home Turn behind GOLDEN EMPIRE.
No report.

After travelling a short distance made contact with A TIME FOR US due to both runners shifting ground.  Leaving the 900 Metres was bumped by A TIME FOR US which shifted in.  Over the concluding stages raced tight between BITS SUPERSTAR and LEADING AGILITY, both of which shifted ground slightly.  L Ferraris stated that his mount raced "flat” tonight.
Bumped at the start.

Jumped only fairly and shortly after the start was steadied when crowded between VIVA BOSS and THE HEIR which shifted out and away from BITS SUPERSTAR.  H Bentley stated that his mount, which was having its first race start at Happy Valley, travelled only fairly in the early stages but he was satisfied with its finishing effort in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Jumped awkwardly, shifted out and made contact with ORIGIN OF FORM.  Between the 300 Metres and the 150 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when being shifted to the outside of WATCH THIS ONE.
Near the 600 Metres was eased to avoid VIVA BOSS which lay out.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
Near the 500 Metres shifted out when being steadied to avoid WATCH THIS ONE.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Bumped shortly after the start.  K C Leung stated that his mount raced keenly throughout the early and middle stages and making the turn after the 600 Metres lay out.  He added in the Home Straight the horse failed to respond to his riding and gave ground.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

H Bowman stated that from the inside barrier his intention was to hold a more forward position than its previous race starts.  He said as a result he rode his mount along in the early stages and when BEAUTY VIVA showed more pace than he had anticipated he was able to settle in a handy position.  Trainer A S Cruz confirmed that the instructions were to hold a more forward position to take advantage of the inside barrier.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Shifted in abruptly on jumping, as a result made heavy contact with STAR ELEGANCE and GLORIOUS JOURNEY and became badly unbalanced.  Sent for sampling post-race.
From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
No report.
Had its right hind plate adjusted in the holding stables, was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race.
No report.
Was obliged to race wide and without cover from the 600 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly and then was checked when crowded by EXCELLENT BOY which shifted in abruptly.

On jumping was bumped heavily on the hindquarters and became unbalanced.  C Y Ho stated that with the early and middle stages of the event being run inside of standard time his mount did not travel well during the event.  He added in the Home Straight and under its top weight of 135 lbs GLORIOUS JOURNEY finished the race off only fairly.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.

Bumped after travelling a short distance.  When questioned J Orman stated that he was asked to go forward but obtain cover if possible.  He said in the early stages, after commencing well, he was obliged to allow his mount to continue forward to cross DASHING PAL and SUPER SICARIO which resulted in ANOTHER ZONDA being positioned outside the leader FRANTANCK.  He added approaching the 1100 Metres ANOTHER ZONDA, which was racing keenly, improved past FRANTANCK and when its rider did not contest the lead he elected to continue forward to cross FRANTANCK after entering the Back Straight near the 900 Metres.  When questioned if there was an opportunity to maintain a position to the outside of FRANTANCK to avoid setting a faster pace J Orman stated that as his mount was racing keenly and he had improved past FRANTANCK he felt that his mount’s best opportunity was to continue forward and cross that runner rather than having to continually restrain his mount.  He further stated that after improving to the lead he was able to reduce the pace through the middle stages of the event in an attempt to assist his mount to finish off in the Home Straight but ANOTHER ZONDA failed to respond to his riding.  Trainer Y S Tsui confirmed the preference was to obtain cover.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, ANOTHER ZONDA will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Bumped after travelling a short distance.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  The performance of DASHING PAL, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, DASHING PAL will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A Badel stated that the intention was to hold a midfield position.  He said after commencing well he was able to settle more forward than anticipated.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped after travelling a short distance.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.

Bumped after travelling a short distance.  From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  When questioned regarding his riding in the middle stages and the reason he did not improve to the outside of CAUSEWAY KING sooner than he did H Bowman stated that after settling back in the field, making the turn near the 500 Metres his mount lay out and became unbalanced which resulted in him having to take hold to balance his horse.  He added that passing the 450 Metres he expected CAUSEWAY KING would shift out as it was racing in a loose one-off position and as a result he remained racing behind that horse as his preference was to improve to its inside.  He said when CAUSEWAY KING did not shift out he then was obliged to improve to that runner’s outside but as he did so CAUSEWAY KING then shifted out near the 350 Metres, resulting in TOGETHER WE VALUE having to make a wide run on the Home Turn.  After considering his explanation the Stewards found the tactics adopted by Jockey Bowman were reasonable in the circumstances.
Bumped shortly after the start.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
Bumped shortly after the start.  Blundered near the 200 Metres.
Bumped shortly after the start.
After travelling a short distance made contact with HORSEPOWER and TOGETHER WE VALUE.

Lay in over the concluding stages when giving ground.  C Y Ho reported that he had to make use of the horse in the early stages to go forward and as a result his mount did not finish the race off in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Jumped only fairly.  A Atzeni stated that his mount, which was having its first race start in Hong Kong, would derive a benefit from tonight’s race experience.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

After being placed in the starting gates reared and became cast for a short period.  Was withdrawn by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice after it was found to be lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, COPPER CORE will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Near the 300 Metres shifted out to improve and made contact with AWESOME TREASURE.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly.
Near the 150 Metres was eased to avoid KING PROFIT (E C W Wong) which shifted out.  E C W Wong was advised to exercise more care.

C Y Ho stated that making the first turn his mount hung out which resulted in him having to correct it at that point.  C Y Ho was fined the sum of $10,000 for using the whip on consecutive occasions in 2 consecutive strides near the 250 Metres.

M F Poon stated that with the early and middle stages of the event being run inside of standard time his mount was unable to finish the race off in the Home Straight, particularly under its top weight of 135 lbs.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

As the start as effected stood flat-footed and was very slow to begin.  The barrier manners of VIGOR ELLEEGANT were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, VIGOR ELLEEGANT will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial.  In the early and middle stages raced keenly and near the 900 Metres was steadied and shifted to the outside of SILVER SPURS.

Near the 1000 Metres was hampered when BRAVE WIN hung out.  D B McMonagle stated that the intention was to hold a handy position.  He added after his mount jumped awkwardly and made contact with CALL TO COMMAND he was caught wide in the early stages.  He said he then elected to obtain a position further back in the field than instructed to avoid racing wide.

On jumping became unbalanced when bumped by SILVER SPURS which shifted out.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.
From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Near the 300 Metres was hampered when MOTOR shifted out and made contact with AWESOME TREASURE, carrying AWESOME TREASURE wider.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

Was withdrawn on raceday morning by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice after sustaining wounds to multiple limbs due to being fractious whilst being transported to the course.  Before being allowed to race again, AMAZING FUN will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Sent for sampling post-race.

Bumped after travelling a short distance.  J Orman stated that with blinkers being applied for the first time he was instructed to go forward and ride the horse in a similar manner when it won a barrier trial at Happy Valley on 14 March 2026 where it wore blinkers.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Jumped awkwardly.  Between the 300 Metres and the 150 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when improving into a narrow run between GIANT LEAP and THE PERFECT MATCH.  Trainer M Newnham confirmed that from the outside barrier the instructions were to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages.
No report.
No report.

Near the 1100 Metres, when being eased to allow BROWNNEEDSFURTHER to cross, was momentarily crowded by BROWNNEEDSFURTHER when that runner was racing tight to the inside of GIANT LEAP which in turn was taken in slightly by THE PERFECT MATCH which shifted in and away from GIANT BALLON despite the efforts of its rider.

Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  D B McMonagle was warned in relation to using his whip in a manner where the hand holding the whip was above shoulder height on one occasion near the 150 Metres.
Bumped at the start.

H Bowman stated that he was given no specific instructions.  He said when his mount jumped well he elected to go forward but was obliged to make too much use of the horse in the early stages which resulted in THE PERFECT MATCH not finishing the race off in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Bumped at the start.  Over the concluding stages raced tight to the inside of STARRY SHOW (L Ferraris) which shifted in.  L Ferraris was advised to exercise more care.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

After travelling a short distance made contact with BROWNNEEDSFURTHER when racing tight to the inside of THE PERFECT MATCH.  A Atzeni stated that his mount jumped only fairly and he was then obliged to make use of it in the early stages to go forward in accordance with his instructions.  He said when caught wide in the early stages he had to continue to make use of the horse to obtain a position outside the lead and as a result in the Home Straight his mount was left without a finishing effort.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of GIANT LEAP was considered disappointing as compared to its previous race start.  Before being allowed to race again, GIANT LEAP will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Bumped on jumping.  Raced keenly in the early stages, resulting in its rider C L Chau making a forward move from the 900 Metres.  Near the 150 Metres C L Chau dropped his whip.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped on jumping.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
No report.
No report.

Shifted out on jumping and made contact with KEEFY.  Z Purton stated that with the early and middle stages of the event being run outside of standard time his mount raced too keenly and as a consequence was unable to run on strongly in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.

Bumped on jumping.  J Orman stated that the intention was to hold a midfield position.  He said in the early stages his mount was caught wide and without cover and when the early stages of the event were run outside of standard time he allowed his mount to stride forward to settle outside the lead to avoid covering additional ground.

Bumped at the start.  M L Yeung stated that after settling back in the field his mount found it difficult to make up ground from that position due to the early and middle stages of the event being run outside of standard time.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

H Bowman stated that his mount was able to hold a handy position in the early stages.  He said when the race quickened from the 800 Metres when WITHOUT COMPARE went forward he was obliged to ride his mount along sooner than he would have liked to maintain a competitive position.  He added after making a wide run on the Home Turn FLYING FORTRESS failed to respond to his riding in the Home Straight and weakened noticeably over the concluding stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Before being allowed to race again, FLYING FORTRESS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
No report.
Jumped only fairly, shifted out and made contact with POSITIVE SMILE.

Withdrawn on 24.3.26 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (fever) and replaced by Standby Declared Starter DARYL FLASH.  Before being allowed to race again, FIVEFORTWO will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Lay in over the concluding stages, resulting in its rider C L Chau correcting his mount approaching the winning post.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Shifted out at the start and was bumped.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
Jumped only fairly and was then shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Between the 300 Metres and the 200 Metres was shifted to the inside to continue into clear running.

Shortly after the start was bumped by PEGAS.  Over the concluding stages could not be fully ridden out when racing in restricted room between GREATER BAE and PEGAS which was taken in by AMAZING KID which shifted in before being corrected by its rider.

Jumped awkwardly and shortly after the start became unbalanced when bumped by SUGAR SUGAR which shifted out slightly.  Over the concluding stages could not be ridden out when racing in restricted room between SYMBOL OF STRENGTH and AMAZING KID which shifted in.
Shortly after the start was crowded between COPARTNER FLEET and AMAZING KID which shifted out.

Between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres was held up for clear running between SYMBOL OF STRENGTH and SUGAR SUGAR.  Passing the 300 Metres was then steadied and shifted to the outside of SUGAR SUGAR to obtain clear running.  Near the 100 Metres raced tight between CHARMING BABE and SUGAR SUGAR which shifted out slightly.

Shifted out slightly soon after the start and was bumped.  E C W Wong stated that from an inside barrier he was instructed to hold an on-pace position.  He added that SUGAR SUGAR did not respond strongly to his riding in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
No report.

J Orman stated that from a wide barrier he had to make use of his mount in the early stages to cross runners to his inside and race outside the lead.  He added that as a result his mount was unable to finish the race off in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Shortly after the start made contact with CHARMING BABE and then was steadied when crowded between CHARMING BABE and MY DAY MY WAY.
